title: German-Style Flatbread with Toasted Sausage
description: A hearty flatbread topped with toasted sausage, onions, and a sprinkle of parsley. Perfect for a quick German-inspired meal.
instructions: Slice the sausages into 1-inch pieces and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle with 1 tablespoon of butter and season with salt and pepper.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes, or until the sausages are toasted and lightly browned.
Meanwhile, slice the onion and separate into rings.
Place the flatbread slices on a baking sheet and brush with remaining 1 tablespoon of butter.
Bake in the oven for 2-3 minutes, or until lightly toasted.
Assemble the flatbread by topping each slice with a toasted sausage, some onion rings, and a sprinkle of parsley.
